title: ISO 42001 Annex A Control A.10 – Third-Party and Customer Relationships
description: Establishes a framework for managing third-party and customer relationships throughout the AI system lifecycle, delineating responsibilities and ensuring accountability to foster ethical, legal, and societal trust.

title: Scope & Critical Nature of Managing Relationships

subsections.heading: Scope and Facilitation of Ethical, Legal, and Societal AI Use
subsections.content: Ensures organisations comprehend duties and remain accountable when risks are shared or transferred to third parties, advocating a structured approach to responsibilities that upholds ethical standards and legal requirements.

subsections.heading: Critical Nature of Managing Relationships
subsections.content: Effective management of third-party and customer relationships ensures all parties know their responsibilities, helps mitigate engagement risks, and safeguards data privacy, security, and AI system integrity.

subsections.heading: Effective Distribution of Responsibilities
subsections.content: Identify AI lifecycle stages and assign specific tasks to qualified entities, using transparent communication and mutual agreement to ensure clear role definition.

subsections.heading: Challenges in Aligning Stakeholders
subsections.content: Navigate diverse objectives and operational frameworks by establishing clear communication channels and agreed collaboration frameworks to overcome ethical and legal discrepancies.

subsections.heading: Streamlining Responsibility Allocation with ISMS.online
subsections.content: Use integrated tools and templates to document and communicate roles, ensuring alignment, accountability, and streamlined responsibility assignment across stakeholders.

subsections.heading: Guiding Organisations in Supplier Relationships
subsections.content: Ensure supplier services, products, or materials align with your responsible AI commitments to maintain ethical standards and legal compliance.

subsections.heading: Establishing Processes for Supplier Alignment
subsections.content: Implement due diligence, continuous monitoring, and regular audits to assess supplier adherence to privacy, security, fairness, and other ethical AI practices.

subsections.heading: Avoiding Common Pitfalls in Supplier Management
subsections.content: Prevent issues like inadequate due diligence or poor performance monitoring by using structured evaluation criteria and updating supplier agreements regularly.

subsections.heading: Documenting and Communicating Supplier Responsibilities
subsections.content: Maintain detailed, accessible records of supplier evaluations, agreements, and performance assessments to ensure transparency and compliance.

subsections.heading: Understanding and Integrating Customer Needs
subsections.content: Engage via surveys, focus groups, and feedback analysis to align AI development with real-world customer expectations and requirements.

subsections.heading: Balancing Innovation with Ethical AI Use
subsections.content: Prioritise fairness, transparency, and privacy when innovating, ensuring AI solutions build and maintain customer trust.

subsections.heading: Strategies for Customer-Centric AI Development
subsections.content: Employ agile, iterative development; implement ethical AI frameworks; and communicate system operations clearly to enhance user satisfaction.

subsections.heading: Contribution to Ethical AI Use
subsections.content: Focusing on customer needs fosters satisfaction and ethical AI deployment, strengthening stakeholder relationships and promoting responsible innovation.

subsections.heading: Best Practices in Documenting AI System Responsibilities
subsections.content: Use standardised templates to record all roles, agreements, and duties throughout the AI lifecycle, and review documentation regularly for accuracy and completeness.

subsections.heading: Mitigating Risks Through Effective Communication
subsections.content: Maintain clear, ongoing communication with all stakeholders to inform about changes and prevent misunderstandings, enhancing risk mitigation.

title: Privacy and Security Considerations in Third-Party Relationships

subsections.heading: Protecting PII in Third-Party Engagements
subsections.content: Encrypt data in transit and at rest, conduct regular security audits, and require third parties to adhere to equivalent privacy and security standards.

subsections.heading: Ensuring Compliance with Global Data Protection Regulations
subsections.content: Perform regular compliance audits, train staff and partners on regulations like GDPR, and update policies as legal requirements evolve.

subsections.heading: Challenges in Maintaining Privacy and Security
subsections.content: Address varying third-party security practices and system vulnerabilities through rigorous risk assessments and continuous monitoring.
